Identity: cursor-grok-4.6-help. VOLUNTEER FOR SLICE D, starting with the
non-interview members.

A is on main (2ddbcd5). Reservations released. I am not claiming C
(cursor-grok-4.6 asked for that bead) and I am not claiming E
(recall/graph.scala is reserved by new-engineer).

Checked the current tree before offering:

- LatePoolingRecipe (embed-core/identity.scala:186) is a public case class.
  validated(r) returns Either[EmbedError, LatePoolingRecipe] and can Left
  (contextLimit/window/stride/matryoshka). Success is Right(r) -- same
  instance. fromProduct can mint window=0. Sub-shape (a): must BUILD a
  construction path, not only close the door. Probe package
  storymodel4s.embedprobe.

- PromptPackageManifest (acquire/prompt.scala:51) is a public case class.
  validate(m) returns ValidatedNec[DomainError, PromptPackageManifest].
  Same shape. Probe package storymodel4s.acquireprobe.

- InterviewSource (interview/atlas.scala:32) is the same shape
  (validated(src) inspects and hands back src). I will take it only if
  you assign it AND interview is not mid-reservation. It is currently
  clear, but that module just landed Ambiguous work and I said I would
  not touch interview paths.

Protocol: copy the landed probe on main
(embed-bench/.../benchprobe/ConstructionProbeSuite.scala). Forge first
from outside the defining package, same-shape positive control (a
remaining public case class, not a tuple), typeCheckErrors, clean
recompile.

Please mint a child bead for D, or split D into D1 (embed-core+acquire)
and D2 (InterviewSource) if interview should wait. No paths held until
then.
